intro: The Test of Righteousness represents a defining trial for rising paladins seeking a sanctified weapon of the Light. The master weaponsmith Jordan Stilwell offers to craft an extraordinary holy armament, tasking the champion with scouring distant lands for rare smithing components, including his lost family hammer.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'd like to reward you if you'd be willing to accept such a thing? Don't misunderstand me, my generosity is dependent on how much help you can be, but I see us both benefiting greatly from such an alliance.

I will craft for you a weapon worthy of what you've accomplished, a symbol of paladinhood and the Light, but you must gather the items I need to craft it. I've already started taking notes on the items, it just requires someone brave and skilled enough to recover them. What do you say, adventurer?

clips.title: Progress
paras: The items you're seeking will be difficult to acquire, but I can assure you, the weapon I will craft for you will be worth the effort.
It will be my finest work to date, and only a small payment for the service you've done me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is wonderful! You've gotten all the items.
I should have no problem forging you a grand weapon with these. I've actually had the plans for doing this for some time, I just never had the opportunity to gather the goods. Thank you, friend.
It feels good to have my father's hammer again... And a Kor gem, I never thought I'd see one of these myself.
